q: Which is generally the best choice for a low-cost, dedicated control task such as a TV remote controller?
options: Pentium-class processor running a full OS
exp: A small 8-bit microcontroller with on-chip memory and I/O is cheap, low power and sufficient for such tasks.

q: The 8085 status signal IO/M is HIGH during
options: an I/O read or write operation
a memory read or write operation
exp: IO/M = 1 indicates an I/O operation and IO/M = 0 a memory operation.

q: The interrupt vector table of the 8086 occupies
exp: There are 256 interrupt types, each with a 4-byte vector (IP, CS), giving 1 KB from 00000H to 003FFH.

q: Which timer mode of the 8051 is the 8-bit auto-reload mode?
exp: Mode 2 uses TLx as an 8-bit counter that is reloaded from THx on every overflow.

q: Which control word, written in BSR mode, sets bit PC3 of the 8255?
exp: BSR format: D7 = 0, D3-D1 = bit number (011), D0 = 1 for set: 0000 0111 = 07H (06H would reset it).

q: The accumulator of an 8085 holds 82H and the instruction RLC is executed. The accumulator and Carry flag become
exp: 82H = 1000 0010. Rotating left, bit 7 (1) goes to CY and into bit 0, giving 0000 0101 = 05H with CY = 1.

q: In an 8086, AL = 7FH, BL = 01H and ADD AL,BL is executed. Which flag outcome is correct?
exp: 7FH + 01H = 80H: no unsigned carry (CF = 0), but two positive numbers give a negative result so OF = 1 and SF = 1.

q: Which special function register of the 8051 holds the serial data for both transmission and reception?
exp: SBUF is the serial buffer: writing sends data, reading gets received data (two physically separate registers at the same address).

q: Which serial bus uses only two lines called SDA and SCL?
exp: The Inter-Integrated Circuit bus uses a serial data line (SDA) and a serial clock line (SCL).

q: How many address lines are required to interface a 4K x 8 memory chip?
exp: 4K = 4096 = 2^12 locations, so 12 address lines are needed.

q: Which of the following 8085 instructions is three bytes long?
exp: STA has an opcode plus a 16-bit address (3 bytes); MVI and IN are 2 bytes and ADD B is 1 byte.

q: Which control word programs counter 0 of the 8253 for Mode 3, binary counting, loading LSB first then MSB?
exp: Format SC1 SC0 RW1 RW0 M2 M1 M0 BCD = 00 11 011 0 = 36H.

q:
Assertion (A): The 8086 can fetch the next instruction while the current one is being executed.
Reason (R): The Bus Interface Unit and the Execution Unit work independently using an instruction queue.
options: Both A and R are true, but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
A is false but R is true
exp: The BIU pre-fetches instructions into the queue while the EU executes, which is exactly what produces the overlap.

q: What is the bit address of bit 3 of the byte at address 28H in the 8051 bit-addressable RAM?
exp: Byte 20H holds bits 00H-07H, so byte 28H starts at 40H; bit 3 is 43H.

q: In an 8085 program A = 38H (BCD) and B = 45H (BCD). After ADD B followed by DAA the accumulator holds
exp: 38H + 45H = 7DH; low nibble D > 9 so DAA adds 06H giving 83H, which is the BCD sum 38 + 45 = 83.

q: After a reset the program counter of the 8085 contains
exp: Reset clears the program counter, so execution starts from 0000H.

q: What is the vector address of RST 6.5 in the 8085?
exp: Vectors: TRAP 0024H, RST 5.5 002CH, RST 6.5 0034H, RST 7.5 003CH.

q: Which pin of the 8051 must be connected to logic 1 to execute programs from the internal ROM?
exp: EA (External Access) = 1 makes the 8051 fetch from internal code memory (below 1000H); EA = 0 forces external memory.

q: Which pin of the 8086 selects between the minimum mode and the maximum mode?
exp: MN/MX is tied high for minimum mode (single processor) and low for maximum mode.

q: Which 8086 instruction reads a byte from port 0F8H directly into AL?
exp: IN AL,port8 reads from an I/O port addressed directly by an 8-bit number.

q: Which 8051 instruction reads a byte from external data memory?
exp: MOVX accesses external data memory; MOVC reads code memory and MOV A,@R1 accesses internal RAM.

q: After reset the 8086 begins executing instructions at physical address
exp: On reset CS = FFFFH and IP = 0000H, so the physical address is FFFF0H.

q: Bidirectional data transfer (Mode 2) of the 8255 is available for
options: both Port A and Port B
exp: Mode 2 is possible only for Group A, i.e. Port A, using PC3-PC7 for handshaking.

q: Which of the following 8085 instructions does NOT affect any flag?
exp: INX (16-bit increment) leaves all flags unchanged, whereas ADD, INR and ANA modify flags.

q: Which interrupt has the highest default priority in the 8051?
exp: The default order is INT0, Timer 0, INT1, Timer 1, Serial.

q: Which hardware unit is used in embedded systems to reset the system automatically when the software hangs?
exp: A watchdog timer must be refreshed periodically by software; if it times out, it resets the processor.

q: The 8051 uses which type of memory architecture?
exp: The 8051 has separate address spaces for program (code) memory and data memory, which is the Harvard architecture.

An 8085 system uses a 6 MHz crystal. How long does a NOP instruction (4 T-states) take?
exp: The 8085 divides the crystal frequency by 2, giving a 3 MHz clock (T = 0.333 microseconds); 4 T-states = 1.333 microseconds.

q: The 8051 serial port in Mode 1 transmits a frame consisting of
options: 9 data bits and no stop bit
exp: Mode 1 is the 8-bit UART with variable baud rate and a 10-bit frame.

q: A counter of the 8253 is operated in Mode 3 with a 2 MHz clock and a count of 2000. The output frequency is
exp: In Mode 3 the output frequency is CLK/N = 2 MHz / 2000 = 1 kHz.

q: An 8085 system uses 8K x 8 memory chips with a 3-to-8 decoder driven by A15, A14, A13. The chip selected when A15 A14 A13 = 010 occupies addresses
exp: 010 followed by 13 address bits spans 0100 0000 0000 0000 to 0101 1111 1111 1111, i.e. 4000H-5FFFH.
